plan.title: Approve exact baseline candidates through a terminal review flow

criteria.description: Approval records exact old/new and input digests, reviewer, reason and time; changed inputs or candidates invalidate the preview.
Non-terminal CLI approval is rejected before mutation.
Interrupted or failed publication preserves the prior baseline without partial metadata.

limitations: TTY is an interaction condition, not human authentication or an agent security boundary.
macOS/Linux terminal detection uses standard-library platform calls; other OS approval is rejected until supported.
Bare legacy baseline snapshots remain readable but require explicit approval metadata before unchanged status.
No automatic surface-to-mode policy, remote publication or physical power-loss guarantee.
